# POLYMARKET DAILY BRIEF | Saturday, September 12, 2026

## Fed Hawkishness Priced In, But 25bps Consensus Could Be Trap

The market has decisively shifted toward a September rate hike, with 78% odds on a 25bps increase now commanding $5.6M in volume. This represents an 18% move higher today, suggesting late institutional positioning ahead of the FOMC decision. The no-change scenario has cratered from ~40% to just 20%, shedding $7.2M in volume—real money rotating out of the dovish trade.

**The signal**: Smart money is pricing certainty where uncertainty likely remains. A 78/20 split on hike vs. hold leaves almost no room for the Fed to surprise with a pause—yet economic data from early September remains mixed. Watch for any last-minute pivot; this market could be vulnerable to a sharp reversal if hawkish guidance softens before announcement.

The LoL esports action (Anyone's Legend vs. Invictus Gaming BO5) is a sideshow—Game 2 at 99% is an execution market, not an insight opportunity. Bitcoin's collapse from 78K+ to sub-2% odds on $78K close is more interesting: spot trading has likely moved below that threshold already, making this a monitor rather than a trade.

## WATCH LIST

**1. Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the September 2026 meeting?** (78%, $5.6M)
Why: Liquidity is here. Any FOMC shift toward pause/cut could cascade into quick reversals. Set alerts if this dips below 70%.

**2. Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the September 2026 meeting?** (20%, $7.2M)
Why: The 20% "no hike" floor is where contrarians live. If dovish rhetoric emerges, this catches a 3-4x move fast.

**3. LoL: Anyone's Legend vs Invictus Gaming (BO5)** (60%, $1.6M)
Why: Series odds (60%) vs. individual games reveal arbitrage gaps. Game 3 at 68% suggests market uncertainty about series length—exploitable if your esports model is sharp.
